title: H-RIVALPARITY-1 item C (measurement, user-approved 2026-09-27): does a CLIENT's shop count as a seller in the HOST's market/demand calculation? READ-ONLY levers providers / marketdemand / rivalincome on BOTH machines for an item the client's own shop really stocks, plus the host-owned control. NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1; 4 rivals). Build with the H-RIVALPARITY-1 levers (providers, marketdemand, rivalincome) deployed on BOTH machines. THE ITEM IS DISCOVERED AT RUNTIME: `providers * *` on the CLIENT names the client's OWN best-stocked demand-capable item (preferring one its own product list also names) and the shop holding it; `stockof` on the client then ASSERTS the premise (the client's shelf really holds that item). The host-owned control is discovered the same way on the host. No lever here writes; no stocking lever exists that is not itself a mutation, so the A/B is ACROSS MACHINES (the same item and neighbourhood read on host and client) rather than before/after a restock. NOTHING is saved.
